name: Custom Pole Flags – Double-Sided Polyester Flags with Pole & Bracket Included
descriptionHtml:
Show your brand, message, or design with confidence using our Custom Pole Flags, designed for easy installation and long-lasting performance indoors or outdoors. These flags are double-sided by default and come complete with a pole and mounting bracket, making them a turnkey solution for storefronts, buildings, events, and promotions.

Available in 2'×3', 3'×5', 4'×6', 4'×8', and 5'×10' sizes, each flag is printed using high-resolution full-color dye sublimation on durable polyester fabric for vibrant, fade-resistant graphics. The flag includes two brass grommets on the top left and bottom corners, ensuring secure and reliable mounting.

Designed to work with any standard flagpole, these flags are easy to hang and built with reinforced stitching for added durability, even in outdoor conditions.

🔹 Key Features

🚩 Double-Sided Printing Included – Your design is visible from both sides
📏 Available Sizes – 2x3, 3x5, 4x6, 4x8, and 5x10
🧵 Durable Polyester Fabric – 4oz banner material for indoor & outdoor use
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, vibrant, fade-resistant printing
🪝 Easy to Hang – Compatible with any standard flagpole
🔩 Grommets Included – Two brass grommets on top left & bottom
🧱 Reinforced Construction –
• Canvas heading with brass grommets
• Double-stitched top & bottom
• Quad-stitched fly end for extra strength
📐 Custom Sizes Available – Call for quote (restrictions may apply)

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation

🔹 Materials

🧵 Flag: 4oz Polyester / Super Poly Knit Fabric
🔩 Grommets: Brass
🪡 Finish: Canvas heading with reinforced stitching

🔹 What’s Included

📦 1× Double-Sided Custom Pole Flag
🪵 1× Pole
🧱 1× Mounting Bracket

🔹 Primary Usage

Storefronts, buildings, outdoor promotions, events, schools, businesses, branding displays, and advertising.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
